project_metadata.name: DocIndexer CLI
project_metadata.summary: High-throughput local document chunking, semantic embedding, and Qdrant vector index synchronization pipeline with incremental file watcher support.

project_description.primary_purpose: DocIndexer monitors multi-format documentation trees (Markdown, PDF, HTML), extracts semantic sections, computes dense embeddings, and synchronizes vector indices in real time without duplicating unchanged documents.
project_description.architecture_and_control_flow: The CLI entrypoint invokes watcher.py to detect file changes. Modified files pass to parser.py which extracts semantic chunks and metadata. Embeddings are computed in batches via embedder.py and ingested into Qdrant using client upsert calls. Telemetry and sync state are persisted to an embedded SQLite state store.
project_description.edge_cases_and_invariants: Embedding failures trigger exponential backoff retry. Unparseable binary documents are quarantined to a dead-letter manifest rather than halting the sync loop. Index updates are strictly idempotent based on SHA-256 document content hashes.

hardware_requirements.notes: CPU-optimized ONNX runtime with support for AVX2 instructions.

cli_flags_or_routes.description: Target root directory of documentation files to index.
Run in daemon mode with continuous file-system monitoring.

entrypoint_and_execution.lifecycle_summary: CLI initializes configuration and verifies database connection, starts file walker or file watcher daemon, processes unindexed documents, and outputs sync summary metrics.

environment_and_secrets.description: Connection URL for the target Qdrant vector database.
FastEmbed model name for local vector generation.

execution_flow.name: CLI Argument Parsing & Env Verification
execution_flow.symbol_invoked: main(dir_path: str, collection: str, watch: bool)
execution_flow.output_contract: IndexConfig object + active Qdrant client connection
execution_flow.mechanism: Validates directory accessibility, tests database reachability, and spins up background worker threads.

execution_flow.name: Document Parsing & Semantic Chunking
execution_flow.output_contract: List[DocumentChunk] with content, token_count, and header_path
execution_flow.mechanism: Extracts plain text and metadata headers, then executes recursive token-bounded chunking.

execution_flow.name: Batch Vector Embedding Generation
execution_flow.mechanism: Feeds batched chunk texts to FastEmbed TextEmbedding ONNX model for vectorized dense representation.

code_anchor.snippet: embeddings = list(model.embed([c.content for c in chunks], batch_size=32))

execution_flow.name: Qdrant Vector Upsert & State Commit
execution_flow.input_contract: Collection name + payload list with vectors and metadata
execution_flow.mechanism: Sends batch points to Qdrant REST/gRPC client and records SHA-256 hash in SQLite state table.
